description: Curated, equally counted capability milestones. Status comes from current registered contracts; no effort or whole-game completion estimate. Shared contracts may contribute to different scoped outcomes.

tracks.title: Engine simulation
tracks.goal: Own world state and execute creature decisions, combat, spells and campaign continuation with explicit original-engine validation boundaries.

focus.boundary: Native headless sessions and playable campaign slices have bounded registered results. Ordinary owner decision traces are original comparisons. Complete original world scheduling, entity lifetime, wizard strategy and full gameplay composition remain open; these milestones do not establish live simulation replacement.

milestones.title: Owned world state & checkpoints
milestones.scope: Native identity, generation checks and versioned staged restoration; native policies retain their own scope.
milestones.remaining: Native ownership/v1 foundation controls pass. Extended checkpoint/preview freshness and original scheduler/lifetime equivalence remain separate.

milestones.title: Native command execution & continuation
milestones.scope: Bounded canonical command context, semantic ingress and portable headless continuation.
milestones.remaining: Extend the installed providers and campaign composition beyond the bounded command session.

milestones.title: Autonomous ordinary creature skirmish
milestones.scope: Installed ordinary type17 three-versus-three owner decisions, task execution and portable continuation under explicit native policies.
milestones.remaining: Extend species, wizard composition, timing and broader world interactions beyond this ordinary bounded encounter.

milestones.title: Original decision pipeline comparisons
milestones.scope: Original-first single-source and multi-source count-budget traces compared with independent native replay, within captured inputs and supplied-service limits.
milestones.remaining: Extend the compared source/task families and world services; original capture is not live native simulation replacement.

milestones.title: Installed creature combat in the native battle
milestones.scope: Bounded ordinary creature selection, ANI-event melee and authoritative health in the authored native battle.
milestones.remaining: Extend species, full original scheduling and wider combat composition.

milestones.title: Cure & Magic Sphere battle integration
milestones.scope: Two named spells with native authoritative health/mana, effect lifetime and save continuation; authored arena policies remain explicit.
milestones.remaining: Extend the spell families and recover full spell selection and original balance before parity claims.

milestones.title: Transactional campaign continuation
milestones.scope: Native attempts, resource rebinding, result settlement and a bounded four-node campaign graph; no original campaign equivalence.
milestones.remaining: Extend mission and campaign scope beyond the authored bounded chapter.

milestones.title: Playable installed-terrain campaign
milestones.scope: Native map campaign and Crossroads windows, semantic orders, typed objectives and paused save/load within registered diagnostic presentation.
milestones.remaining: Review current-source widget validation and extend presentation and original mission behavior beyond the bounded native campaign.

milestones.title: Original wizard strategy & spell tasks
milestones.scope: Whole wizard strategic controller, candidate-to-cast composition and continuation; component comparisons alone do not complete this outcome.
milestones.remaining: Recover coupled wizard source admission, strategic spell selection, summoning and survival, then compare bounded controller execution.

milestones.title: Original world scheduling & entity lifetime
milestones.scope: Original tick/pause scheduler and entity allocation, membership and cleanup; native storage policies do not prove these contracts.
milestones.remaining: Recover and independently compare the complete registered scheduler and lifetime scope.

milestones.title: Complete original gameplay composition
milestones.scope: Registered original AI, combat, casting and campaign progression boundaries; bounded component results remain separate.
milestones.remaining: Recover and integrate the remaining full gameplay contracts without replacing their scope with native policies.

milestones.title: Verified live simulation replacement
milestones.scope: Recovered original world tick and lifetime work bypassed during live native execution, with scoped replacement evidence.
milestones.remaining: Establish integrated equivalence and explicit original-work bypass before claiming live simulation replacement.

tracks.title: Movement & navigation
tracks.goal: Move creatures through a native world with the original route and motion rules.

milestones.title: Cell & occupancy rules compared
milestones.scope: Selected cell and occupancy predicates match controlled original inputs.
milestones.remaining: Finish unresolved pathfinding predicates, clearance and frozen-world boundaries.

milestones.title: Ordinary motion reconstructed
milestones.scope: Selected planar, vertical and route-consumption behavior; controlled comparisons and native headless execution.
milestones.remaining: Extend motion to the missing events, special profiles and environment-dependent cases.

milestones.title: Bounded multi-creature movement
milestones.scope: Native stationary occupancy and bounded multiple movers, tested headlessly.
milestones.remaining: Connect these policies to original dynamic occupancy and broader creature interactions.

milestones.title: Complete pathfinding predicates
milestones.scope: Scoped route validity, clearance and frozen-world input behavior.
milestones.remaining: Finish acceptance, validity, support and clearance branches, then compare the bounded world inputs.

milestones.title: Complete remaining motion events & profiles
milestones.scope: Recovered event handlers, reverse motion and special profile behavior.
milestones.remaining: Recover and implement events 1 and 3–6, reverse motion, special profiles and environment handling.

milestones.title: Original orders & scheduling
milestones.scope: Recover and implement original order, follow-target and scheduling behavior.
milestones.remaining: Recover the order pipeline, scheduler, moving occupancy and follow targets, then compare them against the original.

tracks.title: Native scene & controls
tracks.goal: Interact with a native scene and advance its owned simulation.

milestones.title: Navigate a native map
milestones.scope: Native map navigation and world presentation in a bounded Qt preview.
milestones.remaining: Expand the preview beyond the recorded map and presentation limits.

milestones.title: Select & send creatures to a destination
milestones.scope: Mouse selection and terrain click-to-move apply queued native orders in synthetic scene tests.
milestones.remaining: Recover original input and coordinate rules and cover mixed creature profiles.

milestones.title: Stop & cancel queued movement
milestones.scope: Native queued stop/cancel controls in a synthetic scene preview.
milestones.remaining: Validate behavior beyond the native order policy and current synthetic inputs.

milestones.title: Play & pause simulation
milestones.scope: Bounded native scene playback with an owned tick clock; synthetic preview.
milestones.remaining: Extend playback to a complete owned world and validate original timing separately.

milestones.title: Own a complete scene lifecycle
milestones.scope: Native scene session owns validated world/frozen-navigation construction, semantic command and timer handoff, native save/fresh-window continuation and terminal teardown. This is an explicit native preview contract, independent of original-world gameplay composition.
milestones.remaining: The owned native scene lifecycle passes generated-input Qt/OpenGL, failure/retirement, checkpoint continuation and sanitizer controls. Original world construction/input/timing, arbitrary profiles, hardware recovery and live simulation replacement remain separate.

tracks.title: Rendering & animation
tracks.goal: Draw native game scenes and establish visual equivalence before replacement.

milestones.title: Present through native OpenGL
milestones.scope: Scoped GPU presentation in the recorded Qt/OpenGL preview.
milestones.remaining: Broaden platform and context coverage beyond the recorded preview.

milestones.title: Consume streamed drawing commands
milestones.scope: Bounded incremental native command consumption and live command transport.
milestones.remaining: Extend bounded command coverage and independently validate complete scenes and required graphics side effects.

milestones.title: Observe original startup drawing
milestones.scope: Selected original-game startup commands feed the native shadow renderer. The original still draws.
milestones.remaining: Keep startup observation distinct from the native World viewer and actual drawing bypass.

milestones.title: Compare native World raster composition
milestones.scope: Selected integer World raster modes match independent original replay under controlled inputs; complete consumer side effects and live initial state remain outside this result.
milestones.remaining: Extend independent comparison to complete live scenes, required side effects and additional draw kinds.

milestones.title: Retain owned native canvas history
milestones.scope: Owned native history admits contiguous source frames; original initial pixels are never native rendering inputs.
milestones.remaining: Recover natural initialization and all intervening writes before extending live equivalence.

milestones.title: Present continuous native World frames
milestones.scope: Bounded two-slot World delivery, strict complete frame admission and Qt GPU shadow presentation. Original drawing remains active.
milestones.remaining: Validate camera actions, active battles, transitions, native input/HUD and sustained resource retirement.

milestones.title: Recover from unsupported shadow frames
milestones.scope: Normal capability refusals clear unsupported presentation and resume on a supported complete frame; verification and structural failures remain fatal.
milestones.remaining: Implement unadmitted drawing kinds and extend manual scenario coverage without hiding refusals.

milestones.title: Bypass selected direct-word sprite drawing
milestones.scope: Bounded live equivalence and bypass evidence for selected fully in-bounds direct-word SPR backend entries. Clipped and unsupported draws keep original paths.
milestones.remaining: Extend supported routes and caller-visible behavior before attempting complete-scene takeover.

milestones.title: Replace complete admitted startup World raster queues
milestones.scope: Actual original-body suppression and independent exact-entry pixel/AX comparisons within startup queues1..32; original traversal and outside-World producers remain active.
milestones.remaining: This startup experiment retains its original bounded scope. Later continuous native-only delivery exists under separate contracts; renew comparisons and validate the broader profile rather than treating queue32 as its implementation ceiling.

milestones.title: Replace guarded startup World raster batches
milestones.scope: Mandatory original destination-access guard and one native final writeback per admitted startup World queue; independent original intermediate/AX comparison. This is bounded raster suppression, not complete drawing replacement.
milestones.remaining: This guarded startup experiment retains its own scope. Continuous native-only delivery and ownership services are separate implemented paths; broader current-source original comparison and supported-session acceptance remain validation work.

milestones.title: Native-only launch implemented; combined validation pending
milestones.scope: Delivered startup admission, no hidden original pixel fallback, strict glyph refusal and terminal session accounting. The register retains partial status after shared-source changes.
milestones.remaining: Rerun the declared native-only controls and original-game session against current combined sources; retain route, movie, pixel and performance exclusions.

milestones.title: Owned copy and CPU-reader implementations; validation pending
milestones.scope: Delivered format/stretch conversion, checked native image-row copying and owned raw instruction continuation. Native policies remain separate from original-driver equivalence.
milestones.remaining: Renew source-bound copy and CPU-read/restore controls and integrated original-game caller journeys after the shared renderer edits.

milestones.title: Extended 2D operations and whole clipped-image copy
milestones.scope: Bounded ROP3, key, rotation/palette/display-depth native-policy controls and isolated full 533a00 body copying. Current component evidence is separate from complete application caller coverage.
milestones.remaining: Extend required live caller/transition and original-driver validation; retain the independent whole-game acceptance gates.

milestones.title: Isolated renderer fault and platform recovery
milestones.scope: Opt-in worker replacement, exactly-once draw retry, checkpoint/journal replay and Qt platform recreation under real OpenGL synthetic controls.
milestones.remaining: Validate actual-game fault continuation, physical hardware reset and sustained recovery/IPC/readback cost; synthetic controls do not establish those outcomes.

milestones.title: Native-only hard restart implemented; validation pending
milestones.scope: Delivered generation retirement, fresh launcher/channel admission and preserved failure outcomes. Earlier successful live restart evidence remains historical after shared-source edits.
milestones.remaining: Renew current-source controls and bounded live failure/restart with independent retirement, new-generation and normal-Quit checks.

milestones.title: Compare a bounded complete recorded interval
milestones.scope: All 323 frames in the registered observed-EGL interval have native GPU and displayed X11 comparisons. Original observation closure, generic action-bound journeys and live all-game equivalence remain separate.
milestones.remaining: Grow action-bound supported-session acceptance with complete resource/semantic/pixel checks rather than treating one recorded interval as all-game proof.

milestones.title: Validate the complete original World initialization contract
milestones.scope: Recover canvas allocation, generation, clearing/reuse and upstream producers. Selected retained-state observations do not complete this contract.
milestones.remaining: Native ownership/history implementations exist separately. Recover and compare the remaining original allocation, generation, clearing/reuse and upstream producer scope before promoting this broad recovered contract.

milestones.title: Complete scene & animation drawing
milestones.scope: Scoped native sprite/terrain scenes and original animation placement contracts.
milestones.remaining: Finish surface, sprite, terrain and animation branches and compare complete scenes.

milestones.title: Replace original drawing in live play
milestones.scope: Verified live replacement of the selected original sprite and terrain submissions.
milestones.remaining: Establish live visual equivalence and evidence that original rendering work is bypassed.

milestones.title: Complete supported live drawing replacement
milestones.scope: All declared drawing routes, lifecycle, HUD, transitions and failure/recovery gates must pass for the supported build and scenarios.
milestones.remaining: Complete DRAW-01 through DRAW-07 in the authoritative roadmap and record fresh bypass and supported-session evidence.

focus.boundary: Selected native-only rendering capabilities have bounded implementations, including continuous World delivery, owned copy/CPU-reader paths, clipped-image copying, extended 2D and isolated renderer recovery. The full rendering and animation track still contains partially implemented and unimplemented contracts. Implementation status and execution validation are reported separately below; complete live drawing replacement is not certified.
focus.next_task: Renew combined-source native-only launch, copy/CPU-reader and hard-restart controls and original-game journeys. Then close enabled movies, storage/transitions, live renderer faults, independent presented-session pixels and sustained hardware performance within a declared supported scope. Component controls already pass for extended 2D/image operations and isolated recovery; they do not certify all-game replacement. Preserve historical results and record new execution under new evidence IDs.
focus.implementation_title: Resolve original and aggregate rendering scope
focus.implementation_task: Use the per-contract reconciliation before adding code. Existing bounded algorithms/services and diagnostic tools are accounted for separately. AN.world-facing now links the existing native provider arithmetic; complete original targeting/lifetimes remain open. Recover the unresolved original contracts and reconcile broad surface/palette/recovery/retirement entries against their narrower supplied implementations before sizing additional implementation work.

tracks.title: Effects & lighting
tracks.goal: Reproduce effect movement, creature collisions and terrain lighting.

milestones.title: Static lighting composition
milestones.scope: Scoped static admission/refresh and owned composition, compared against controlled original inputs and previewed.
milestones.remaining: Expand input production and unsupported lighting sources beyond the bounded static path.

milestones.title: Bounded effect motion & terrain exits
milestones.scope: Selected effect trajectories, cell transitions, blocked destinations and height exits, compared and exercised headlessly.
milestones.remaining: Cover unimplemented effect setup, creation variants and movement recount.

milestones.title: Effect / creature collision
milestones.scope: Scoped candidate occupancy and collision behavior under controlled comparisons and native headless scenarios.
milestones.remaining: Extend beyond the recorded candidate, ordering, footprint and mixed-exit limits.

milestones.title: Complete effect creation & light inputs
milestones.scope: Recovered input production, effect setup and creation variants.
milestones.remaining: Recover static input production, special size-one handling, creation variants and movement recount.

tracks.title: Audio
tracks.goal: Load, schedule, position and play audio with recovered engine semantics.

milestones.title: Scoped PCM loading & storage
milestones.scope: Native wave loading and sample buffer storage with bounded execution evidence.
milestones.remaining: Finish supported formats, lifetime and failure boundaries and record scoped execution.

milestones.title: Scoped mixing & playback
milestones.scope: Native voice state, mixer and output backend exercised together.
milestones.remaining: Native PCM, mixer and bounded Qt push-output controls pass. Physical playback/timing, original-driver equivalence and complete audio-manager semantics remain separate.

milestones.title: Original voice & positional rules
milestones.scope: Original scheduling, admission, lifetime and positioning independently compared.
milestones.remaining: Recover remaining voice scheduling, admission, attenuation and lifetime branches and compare them.

milestones.title: Integrated audio manager
milestones.scope: Recovered manager lifecycle connected to the native backend.
milestones.remaining: Finish manager lifecycle/configuration and bridge behavior, then exercise the combined manager.

tracks.title: Assets & persistence
tracks.goal: Load game data natively and preserve saved state.

milestones.title: Scoped file access & profiles
milestones.scope: Bounded native file access, profile loading and persistence.
milestones.remaining: Supported native file/profile and persistence-envelope controls pass. General Windows API equivalence and complete saved-world interpretation remain separate.

milestones.title: Scoped map & region loading
milestones.scope: Native maps, terrain catalogs and region recipes.
milestones.remaining: Version-6 MAP, version-4 TTD record and native recipe controls pass. Older MAP conversion, all terrain semantics, world generation and entity construction remain separate.

milestones.title: Scoped graphics asset loading
milestones.scope: Native sprite, animation, cursor and PCX readers.
milestones.remaining: Supported SPR v2/v4, ANI v3/v4/v5, CUR 1/8-bpp and PCX 8-bit one-plane controls pass. Other encodings and original-equivalent drawing/runtime allocation remain separate.

milestones.title: Restore a complete saved world
milestones.scope: Saved world data reconstructed into owned native state.
milestones.remaining: Recover missing world state and complete save/load behavior beyond current readers.

tracks.title: Menus & campaign
tracks.goal: Navigate menus into a playable campaign and back.

milestones.title: Observe preference apply & persistence
milestones.scope: Scoped original preference apply/rebuild observation plus bounded native draft/persistence policies.
milestones.remaining: Complete other preference callers and unsupported display/control transitions.

milestones.title: Bridge region entry & world handoff
milestones.scope: Selected region-entry and campaign handoff paths observed live; original engine owns gameplay.
milestones.remaining: Broaden regions, initialization and transition coverage; establish native world ownership independently.

milestones.title: Return from a campaign mini-menu
milestones.scope: Scoped Cancel path and lifecycle observed in the original campaign hierarchy.
milestones.remaining: Complete remaining mini-menu actions beyond the registered Cancel scope.

milestones.title: Complete native menu flows
milestones.scope: Native main, quick battle, preferences and save/load interfaces with integrated scenarios.
milestones.remaining: Finish native screen behavior, services, save/load and cross-screen transitions.

milestones.title: Own campaign navigation & admission
milestones.scope: Native campaign initialization, realm navigation and region admission.
milestones.remaining: Implement recovered campaign state transitions and realm initialization beyond observation/adapters.

tracks.title: Core gameplay & spells
tracks.goal: Run original simulation, AI, combat, spells and progression natively.

milestones.title: Original simulation tick & lifetime
milestones.scope: Recovered simulation tick and entity lifetime rules.
milestones.remaining: Recover and implement the original scheduler, ticking and entity lifecycle contracts.

milestones.title: AI & combat
milestones.scope: Recovered creature decisions and combat resolution.
milestones.remaining: Recover and implement AI and combat, keeping balance changes separate.

milestones.title: Spell casting & dispatched effects
milestones.scope: Recover casting and all explicitly registered spell dispatch cases. The dispatch checklist contributes one milestone.
milestones.remaining: Implement casting and the currently unimplemented spell effects; mapping a case is not executing it.

milestones.title: Original progression
milestones.scope: Recovered progression and persistent gameplay rules.
milestones.remaining: Recover and implement progression before introducing intentional gameplay changes.

tracks.title: Future gameplay changes
tracks.goal: Add the planned gameplay changes after baseline engine validation.

milestones.title: Commander orders for summoned creatures
milestones.scope: Intentional new gameplay policy, separate from the original baseline.
milestones.remaining: Design and implement commander orders after validating the baseline order and simulation contracts.

milestones.title: Per-creature veterancy
milestones.scope: Intentional new progression policy.
milestones.remaining: Design and implement per-creature veterancy after baseline progression is understood.

milestones.title: More active mana economy
milestones.scope: Intentional new economy/balance policy.
milestones.remaining: Design and implement the mana tempo/economy change after baseline gameplay validation.
